title: Capitalization Table

origin.title: Sample Cap Table (Pro Forma): Acme, Inc. Capitalization Table (Pro-Forma)
origin.clearance_note: A sample published by the law firm Cooley LLP on its Cooley GO startup resource site for general use, linked from https://www.cooleygo.com/documents/sample-cap-table-pro-forma/. Downloaded by script. All holders are specimen placeholders (Investor #1-#5, Founder #1-#2, New Investor) of a fictional Acme, Inc., so no content was redacted. The PDF's metadata (firm name as author, Excel as creator, creation date) and its tagged-PDF structure tree were cleared; no personal data was in it. Cooley also publishes the same workbook as a legacy .xls with two more sheets; this PDF is Cooley's own print of the Post-$ Pro Forma sheet only.

notes: The request named only the document and its URL. The operator chose Cooley's 1-page PDF print over the legacy .xls workbook it was printed from: ADE accepts no .xls (v1 or v2), and the PDF needs no change to the shared tooling. The featured fields tell the story of the Series B round the table models: the new investor's Series B shares, the option pool top-up that comes with the round, the Series A already outstanding, and the fully diluted share count after both. All five read ok in inspect_fields.py. No person is featured; every holder is a placeholder. Dash cells (zero holdings) extract correctly as 0 but cannot be featured, since a dash does not contain the value 0.
